description: § 172(b)(2)(A) and (d)(2)(A) (derived). Single 2026: wages $119,100, § 1211(b) capital loss deduction $3,000, post-2017 NOL $500,000. Taxable income without the NOL: 119,100 − 3,000 − 16,100 = $100,000 → deduction 80% = $80,000. Modified taxable income adds back the $3,000 capital loss: $103,000, less 20% × 100,000 = $83,000 absorbed → carryover $417,000, NOT 500,000 − 80,000 = $420,000.
